approvers: Owner decides alone; I would only recommend
reason: We don't buy this today, and I'd rather clean frames at handover the way we always have than add a new supplier and a budget line. The owner won't pay about €19/m² on small house and block jobs, and I don't want to answer for a coating that marks the frames.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and I'm the one with the snagging list.
instead: Cheap protection film and tape from the hardware store, covering windows by hand, and cleaning glass at handover.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee from ACHV, backed by insurance, that they pay for any damage to frames or glass from the coating or its removal, plus a nearby site I can visit to see it peeled off clean.
